description: This file defines a utility class 'BCryptHelper' providing methods to extract information, specifically the number of iterations, from bcrypt password hashes. It primarily contains a regex pattern and a static method to parse bcrypt hashes.

classes.name: BCryptHelper
classes.description: A final utility class with static methods for handling bcrypt hashes, including extracting the iteration count and validating bcrypt hash format.

methods.name: getIterations
methods.description: Parses a bcrypt hash string and returns the number of iterations used. Throws IllegalArgumentException if the hash is invalid or not using version 2a.
